completionSentence: 사용자는 이미 설치·로그인한 앱·CLI·OS 능력을 다시 설정하지 않고 사용하며, T5는 비밀값을 모델과 일반 Terminal에 노출하지 않고 현재 계정·권한·실행 결과를 확인한다.
closingPrinciple: 등록된 능력만 등록된 행동으로 실행하고, 비밀은 그 능력의 소유 경계를 떠나지 않으며, T5는 계정·권한·실행·효과를 각각 관측해 남긴다.

comparatorSourceAudit.sourceAvailability: main implementation source unavailable; official product documentation inspected
rejected: documentation-only behavior as a source implementation oracle

qualified: One capability-use receipt schema keeps credential ownership, observed authority, actual execution and effect observation as separate facts for all four capability kinds.

The existing GitHub CLI registration remains direct-argv and read-only, rejects token display, writes, GraphQL, absolute API URLs and foreign hosts, and now observes the current account plus reported scopes without returning raw credential material.
GitHub CLI credential directories and Keychain access are denied to the general macOS Terminal while the exact registered CLI action can use the CLI-owned login.
Detected Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive and iCloud roots are represented only as current local filesystem reality; remote account and synchronization success remain unobserved.
Existing official remote connection tools retain their own secure credential and execution path while emitting the same separated capability receipt facts.
Finder, Windows Explorer or the platform file manager is invoked through one fixed direct-argv reveal action without a shell string or credential.

One product journey combines a local synchronized file, an already-authenticated GitHub CLI, an official remote connection and the native file manager without asking the user to select internal tools.

A platform without qualified general-Terminal isolation does not advertise or execute an authenticated CLI broker; Windows stays explicitly unqualified until its physical isolation implementation exists.
